verdict.rationale: The pack has only a bare "AI & Automation" feature heading. It never says that AI generates job descriptions, outreach sequences, or rejection notes, or that it matches the recruiter's tone. Email templates and candidate emailing are adjacent manual features, not AI-drafted content, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI drafts the words — job descriptions, outreach sequences, and rejection notes generated in my tone from the role's context
